_comment: Mock review dataset for offline end-to-end testing of the pipeline. Curated to cover multiple topics (subscription, crashes, video, content variety, praise) so the mock LLM produces coherent topics/findings/PRD. Loaded by scripts/test-mock.mjs and importable via the UI's CSV/JSON upload.

meta.description: Mock dataset — not real App Store metadata.

reviews.author: JaneD
reviews.title: Scam subscription
reviews.content: Signed up for the free trial and was charged $59.99 immediately. No clear cancel button anywhere. Refund please!

reviews.author: MikeT
reviews.title: Hidden pricing
reviews.content: The subscription price is not shown until after you enter your card. Too expensive compared to other workout apps. Cancelling.

reviews.author: SarahL
reviews.title: Auto renew trap
reviews.content: Auto-renewed without any reminder email. Tried to get a refund through support and got no response. Avoid this subscription model.

reviews.author: EmilyR
reviews.title: Trial to paid scam
reviews.content: Trial ended and I was charged the full year with no warning. The paywall is confusing and the cancel flow is buried in settings.

reviews.author: TomW
reviews.title: Crashes on launch
reviews.content: After the 7.3.0 update the app crashes immediately on launch on iPhone 12. Reinstalled, restarted, nothing works. Completely broken.

reviews.author: LisaK
reviews.title: Freezes mid-workout
reviews.content: App freezes every time I start the second set of any workout. Have to force quit and lose progress. Happens on iOS 17.

reviews.author: CarlosM
reviews.title: Broken after update
reviews.content: Latest update broke everything. Crashes, glitches, lost all my saved workouts. Was great before 7.3.0 — please fix the crashes and bugs.

reviews.author: NinaP
reviews.title: Glitchy video player
reviews.content: The video keeps pausing and buffering even on wifi. Sometimes the sound cuts out mid-exercise. Very frustrating for a paid app.

reviews.author: RobH
reviews.title: Audio sync issues
reviews.content: Voice coach audio is out of sync with the video countdown. Otherwise the workouts are decent but this audio bug really breaks the flow.

reviews.author: AmyS
reviews.title: Good but loading slow
reviews.content: Love the workout variety but video loading is slow. Once it starts it's fine. Please optimize the playback and loading experience.

reviews.author: BethO
reviews.title: Best home workout app
reviews.content: Absolutely love this app. The variety of workouts and trainers keeps me motivated every day. Perfect for beginners and intermediate alike. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: GregF
reviews.title: Great exercise routines
reviews.content: The exercise routines are well-designed and the plan adapts to my level. Amazing variety of workouts from yoga to HIIT. Best workout program I've used.

reviews.author: IrisN
reviews.title: Motivating voice coach
reviews.content: The voice coach is so motivating and the music selection is perfect. I look forward to my daily routine now. Keep up the great work!

reviews.author: KateM
reviews.title: Good variety, needs more
reviews.content: Good variety of workouts but I wish there were more intermediate-level trainers and longer programs. Overall solid exercise app.

reviews.author: DanP
reviews.title: Perfect for beginners
reviews.content: As a beginner I found this perfect. The trainer explains every exercise clearly and the program builds up gradually. Love the workout variety and the motivat voice coach.

reviews.author: MiaQ
reviews.title: Decent but pricey
reviews.content: Workouts are decent but the subscription is too expensive for what you get. Considering cancelling unless there's more content added.

reviews.author: OwenR
reviews.title: Refund ignored
reviews.content: Requested a refund for the auto-renew charge and support has not responded in two weeks. The cancel flow is also confusing and the paywall is misleading. Refund please.

reviews.author: PiaS
reviews.title: Crash on iPad
reviews.content: App crashes when I open the trainer selection screen on iPad. Works on iPhone but the iPad crash bug makes it unusable on the bigger screen.

reviews.author: QuinnT
reviews.title: Great trainers, minor bugs
reviews.content: The trainers are great and the workout variety is excellent. Some minor glitches and freezes occasionally but nothing deal-breaking. Fix the crashes and it's 5 stars.

reviews.author: RitaV
reviews.title: Changed my routine
reviews.content: This app changed my daily routine. The variety of workouts and the motivating voice coach make it the best exercise app I've tried. Love the program structure and trainer videos.
